import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

    sr=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(gi[r]))==1 and gi[r][0]!=0]
    sc=[c for c in range(W) if len({gi[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1 and gi[0][c]!=0]
    Rb=[0]+sr+[H]; Cb=[0]+sc+[W]

            I=[[gi[r][c] for c in range(Cb[bj],Cb[bj+1])] for r in range(Rb[bi],Rb[bi+1])]
            O=[[go[r][c] for c in range(Cb[bj],Cb[bj+1])] for r in range(Rb[bi],Rb[bi+1])]
            oc=sorted({v for row_ in I for v in row_ if v!=0 and v!=I[0][0]}) if False else None
            objcol=[v for row_ in I for v in row_ if v!=0 and v!=gi[bi*10+bj]]
            # object color: nonzero values that aren't the separator value
            sepv=gi[r][0] if any(all(x==v for x in gi[r]) for r in range(min(sr,[r for r in range(H) if all(x==gi[r][0] for x in gi[r]]) )) ) else None
            nz={v for row_ in I for v in row_ if v!=0}
            # separator value = most common overall nonzero forming full lines; object color = nonzero != all of those

            ocol=set(nz-{sepv})

import numpy as np
def tiles_of(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    rs=[i for i in range(H) if all(I[r][j]==I[r][0] for r in range(H) for j in [i] if I[r][j]!=0)]
    # robust: line if uniform nonzero
    rs=[i for i in range(H) if len({I[r][i] for r in range(H)})==1 and I[i][0]!=0]
    cs=[j for j in range(W) if len({I[i][j] for i in range(H)})==1 and I[0][j]!=0]
    def split(n,seps):
        res=[];s=0
        for p in sorted(seps)+[n]:
            if s<p: res.append((s,p)); s=p+1
        return res
    return split(H,rs),split(W,cs)
I1=G['Demo pair 1 input']; O1=G['Demo pair 1 output']
rb,cb=tiles_of(I1)
for (a,b) in rb:
    for (c,d) in cb:
        S=np.array([[I1[r][cc] for cc in range(c,d)] for r in range(a,b)])
        T=np.array([[O1[r][cc] for cc in range(c,d)] for r in range(a,b)])
        print(S.tolist(),'->',T.tolist())
I2=G['Demo pair 2 input']; O2=G['Demo pair 2 output']
rb2,cb2=tiles_of(I2)
for (a,b) in rb2:

        T=np.array([[O2[r][cc] for cc in range(c,d)] for r in range(a,b)])
        print('in',S.tolist(),'out',T.tolist())
